summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py (TaskProgressColumn.show_speed and static render_speed, track() show_speed option defaulting to True, Progress.track unknown-total handling with no ValueError), added the CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line, removed the two ValueError assertions in tests/test_progress.py, and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was committed and no tests or repository code were run, so all changes are verified by reading only. Two points remain unchecked: that add_task/update accept a None total, and that filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix behaves as the spec describes at the scale boundaries.
